question: Direction: 11.3.5.1 says the remote syncs with the home box's database and that the sync is the backup. Is the sync home to remote only, or both ways (a node only the remote holds also goes to the home)?
why_it_blocks: the build moves home to remote only; a both-ways sync needs the home to accept writes from a remote into tables its devices own
answer: Settled by Q#114 (open-34c4451291a6, Akien 2026-11-14): every write goes to the home's proxy and the home is the one writer, so no node is held only by a remote. Data flows home to remote, by the read fill and the sleep-cycle sync (Q#113, open-d943155b9c86); a box may also fill from another non-home host's proxy, but every row it gets was written at the home. Outline 4.3.1.5.1.4.1.2. - akienasus_cc_0
